name: Washington

fees.note: Single-trip dimensional permit $10 (3-day). Statute applies $10 to all overlegal loads except overweight; overweight loads pay the weight fee instead (see overweight line).

Per-mile rate by pounds over legal capacity (greater of gross or axle excess); $4.25 at 100,000 lb excess plus $0.50 per additional 5,000 lb (table here stops at 400,000 lb excess). Minimum $14; rounded to nearest dollar. Excess here is gross minus 80,000, which can overstate it for vehicles legal above 80,000 in WA.
Superload: if WSDOT pavement/structure analysis needs significant resources, applicant may be asked to share the cost (estimate given first).

restrictions.text: May be restricted on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, Christmas, starting at noon the day before.
May be restricted on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, Christmas, starting at noon the day before.
Commuter-hour restrictions on specified high-volume state highway sections (areas, hours and widths published by WSDOT and attached to the permit).
Night movement only if 'night movement approved' is on the permit. No movement with visibility under 500 ft or hazardous road conditions (snow, ice, slides, wind, flooding).

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
travel.note: Night movement only when the permit says so.

notes: Overwidth maximums: 14 ft on two-lane highways, 20 ft on barrier-divided multilane, 32 ft on undivided multilane (wider only where design allows).

Escort length triggers in WAC are trailer length including load (105 ft two-lane, 125 ft multilane); this file uses overall length, which triggers slightly earlier. Rear-overhang over 1/3 of trailer length, or 20 ft on single units, also needs a rear escort on two-lane highways.

Superload: >200,000 lb, >16 ft high, >16 ft wide or trailing unit + load >125 ft. Apply 30 days ahead if over 200,000 lb, 7 days if dimensional only. Extra pilots and/or law enforcement may be required case by case.
Legal gross in WA is axle/bridge-table based up to 105,500 lb; verify overweight status against axle configuration.
